engine: PGlite PostgreSQL; Supabase auth and storage mocked

checks.name: All 88 migrations preserve existing finished products as made-in-house
Ingredients, packaging and supplies have a single purchase registry
Resale opt-in is explicit, audited and preserves stock
Reference photos, preferred supplier and supplier SKU remain tenant-scoped
Normal product IDs cannot be ordered or used in purchase needs; legacy routes reject
Each purchase type supports approval, PO, barcode checks, receiving and idempotent retry
Preferred and approved-substitute barcode verification; mismatch override audit
Resale receiving increases sellable stock once and POS decreases it once
Expired resale lots block POS and roll back every stock balance
Resale stock cannot be reclassified or consumed through production
Made-in-house production consumes recipe ingredients once
Roles and tenant boundaries protect classification, purchase items and private helpers

limitations: Live Supabase RLS/storage/Edge and multi-session concurrency require staging UAT.
